The '''Main Habitat''' of the [[Polis Massa Research Base]] consisted of a number of rooms that could be adapted to fit any [[Species/Legends|species]]. A small number of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] stayed in the Habitat during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
